targeting.source: GOB Fumble Field stores selected hostile, 12 m range, Hacker Style, CastWhenUsed=1 and viral TestFunction=2.
targeting.runtime: The ordinary cast validates loaded membership, a living hostile view/spawn, sight, range, Hacker Style and outside-combat state before spending IS. Landing requires the same live enemy and range. A recipient deflects before any modifier is applied.
targeting.test: FumbleFieldAndUiLagBindTheOriginalHostileBeforeSpendingOrLanding checks ordinary refusal packets, absence of a debit or timer on refusal, in-flight target invalidation and a complete valid cast. FumbleFieldAndUiLagApplyEveryTypedModifierAndExpireOnIndependentRecipients deflects the primary while an eligible secondary still receives its own modifiers.

area.source: GOB 361 stores CastDirectObjects=3 and radius 8 m.
area.runtime: The selected enemy supplies the area centre. Each eligible hostile must be within 8 m and visible, including a valid sight path from the centre. The caster, friend, hidden character and next-centimetre recipient are excluded.
area.test: FumbleFieldAndUiLagApplyEveryTypedModifierAndExpireOnIndependentRecipients verifies exact 8.00/8.01 m, independent contests, both add/remove packet records and unmodified HP. FumbleFieldAndUiLagRequireSightFromTheirSelectedCentreToEachSecondary exercises a mapped obstructed secondary inside the radius. The stock fixture prepares verified stands for native confirmation.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 465 stores -20 ballistic/thrown accuracy and -18 ballistic/thrown defence for 17 s, 20 base IS, 2 s casting, and 30 s own reuse.
behavior-tests.runtime: A successful ordinary cast emits 524/1032 at -20 and 1010/1011 at -18, which feed the ballistic and thrown combat consumers through expiry. The ranked native profile includes Dedicated Code, lowering effective cost to 17 IS.
behavior-tests.test: UiLagRankTwoChangesBallisticAndThrownContestsUntilExpiry exercises all four combat consumers. FumbleFieldAndUiLagApplyEveryTypedModifierAndExpireOnIndependentRecipients verifies all four individual record IDs on add/remove. FumbleFieldAndUiLagUseTheFullRankedCostAndTheirOwnNativeTimers checks cost and timer inputs, and the ordinary request tests cover admission and landing.
